name: indo_arab_desert
note: Indo-Arab Desert Adventure: Driving Malfuf/Maqsum camel caravan pulse, Maqam Hijaz / Raga Bhairav augmented-second mystery, authentic Oud and Sitar dialogue, breathy Ney/Bansuri desert wind, crisp Darbuka and Daf frame drums, and grand cinematic string/horn adventure builds.
sources: Arabic Maqam Hijaz (D Eb F# G A Bb C D) & Indian Raga Bhairav / Basant Mukhari desert modes
Traditional desert rhythms: Malfuf (2/4 caravan pulse) and Maqsum (4/4 Egyptian/Bedouin groove) merged with Indian Dadra and Teental subdivisions
Acoustic orchestration: Oud, Ney, Sitar, Darbuka, Riq, Daf frame drum, and cinematic low strings
